XSN clkn ckn sub rppd w=4u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XUP avdd ckp sub rppd w=1u l=4u b=0 sw_et=1

physical_texts.clock_div2_hbt.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Native HBT master/slave toggle prescaler, not a PLL/CDR or PCIe PHY.
* Include the exact frozen rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice before this subcircuit.
* Master tracks low clock, slave high; slave QN/Q drives master DP/DN.
* Independent nominal2.5V rail and a native resistor/HBT bias reference.
* Small fixed native MIM mismatch supplies a physical startup asymmetry.
* No ideal clock, gain, logic state, IC, UIC or startup current kick exists.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_hbt clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=12.7u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_hbt
physical_texts.clock_div4_hbt_v10.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Separate v10: only second-stage reference XBIAS length12.7um to11.5um; clock pull-downs8um and both24um MIMs retained.
* The first core retains its upward common-mode network. The second network
* lowers the first core's high output common mode; no ideal level shift.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=11.5u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10

.subckt nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XFIRST clkp clkn s1p s1n avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt_v3
* Real input bias, limiter reference and differential pair; no ideal gain.
XLSP s1p bip sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLSN s1n bin sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDP bip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDN bin avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLB avdd lref sub rppd w=1u l=9u b=0 sw_et=1
XLREF lref lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XLP ln bip lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN lp bin lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLT lt lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XLRP avdd lp sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XLRN avdd ln sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
* The unchanged real MIM feed-forward topology preserves clock swing.
XSP lp ckp sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XSN ln ckn sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ckp avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN ckn avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XCP lp ckp cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XCN ln ckn cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XSECOND ckp ckn qp qn avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10
.ends nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10

physical_texts.pll_feedback_div20_lv_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Original finite 2GHz CML-to-CMOS receiver and divide-by-20 prerequisite.
* Two native toggles and a synchronous modulo-five feed a real HV level shifter.
* 1.2V CMOS and 2.5V output supply; no ideal internal clock or divider.
* Isolated schematic development only; no closed PLL, PVT or layout acceptance.
* Original gate topology adapted from the frozen HV PFD; native LV MOS only.
* No ideal internal clock, divider, voltage gain or source.
.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native MIM restrains actual reset-induced n1 charge feedthrough.
XSTAB n1 vss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2 d clk clearb q qb vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XSQB snr q clearb qb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2 cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub
* Native one-third-voltage passive bias matches the measured 2.39V CML CM.
XRP cp ip sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN cn inn sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN inn avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
* Actual LV differential pair/current mirror, not a behavioral comparator.
XRB cvdd bias sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF bias bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XT tail bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=2.96u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNP diode ip tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNN gain inn tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPP diode diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPN gain diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native AC coupling and resistive feedback set the actual inverter bias.
XAC gain gate cap_cmim w=5u l=5u
XRFB pre gate sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XCORE gate pre cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XBUF pre mid cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XOUT mid clk cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2 cp cn clearb q qb avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFF qb clk clearb q qb cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2

* Original synchronous modulo-five; all unused states recover to zero.
.subckt nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub
XFF0 d0 clk clearb q0 q0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF1 d1 clk clearb q1 q1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF2 d2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XD0N q2b q0b d0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD0I d0b d0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XX0 q1 q0 xn0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX1 q1 xn0 xn1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX2 q0 xn0 xn2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX3 xn1 xn2 xq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1N q2b xq d1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1I d1b d1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XD2N q2b q1 q0 d2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XD2I d2b d2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2 d db q qb avdd avss sub
* Real cross-coupled HV PMOS with LV-driven HV NMOS; no voltage gain source.
XPL qb right avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPR right qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNL qb d avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNR right db avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPBUF q qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNBUF q qb avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_div20_v2 cp cn clearb fb fbbar avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFAST0 f0b clk clearb f0 f0b cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFAST1 f1b f0 clearb f1 f1b cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XCOUNT f1 clearb count countb cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2
XLEVEL count countb fb fbbar avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_feedback_div20_v2
physical_texts.pll_feedback_vco_v6_divider_tail115_v1_w:

XOSC vco_avdd avss clkn clkp sub vctrl body_substrate wire_cref nssoc_vco_local_hybrid_open_v2

physical_texts.pll_pfd_charge_pump_hv_v1.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Original static HV-CMOS phase/frequency detector and switched mirror pump.
* Nominal AVDD=2.5V. REF/FB/RESET are external full-swing logic inputs.
* RESET is active high. UP/DOWN are active high; positive CP current charges
* an external filter. No internal ideal sources, delay, switches or clocks.
* This is a development primitive, not a closed PLL or a qualified interface.

.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA n a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b n vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB y b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1

* Rising-edge static master/slave DFF; active-low clear resets BOTH latches.
* The clear also inhibits both set inputs, avoiding a clear/set contention.
.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1 d clk clearb q vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQB snr q clearb qb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down vdd vss sub
XUP vdd ref clearb up vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XDN vdd fb clearb down vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XBOTH up down bothb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XD0 bothb delay0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD1 delay0 delay1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD2 delay1 both vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCLR both reset clearb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1

* One resistor-defined NMOS bias sets both the sink and mirrored PMOS source.
* Actual series MOS switches gate the two output paths; compliance is measured.
.subckt nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1 up down out vdd vss sub
XRBIAS vdd nb sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XNREF nb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XNBIAS pb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPREF pb pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPSOURCE source pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=6.4u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPENABLE out upb source vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNENABLE out down sink sub sg13_hv_nmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNSINK sink nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XUB up upb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down cp avdd avss sub
XPFD ref fb reset up down avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1
XCP up down cp avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1
physical_texts.rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Development CML master/slave sampler, not a CDR or complete PCIe PHY.
* External AVDD=2.5 V, AVSS=0 V, IREF=0.5 mA and differential clock required.
* RX v2 remains separately powered from 1.8 V. Native resistive level shift
* loads its actual outputs; no ideal voltage gain or behavioral latch exists.
* Clock target: 8 GHz, common mode 1.29 V, differential levels +/-0.30 V.
* Preamplifier/substrate/pad parasitics are not supplied by this schematic.

.subckt nssoc_cml_latch dp dn qp qn cp cn avdd avss sub ref
XDP qn dp se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XDN qp dn se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLP qn qp he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN qp qn he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XCS se cp te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XCH he cn te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XT te ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XRP avdd qp sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN avdd qn sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
* Weak native bleeders keep the inactive emitter nodes from floating.
XBS se avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XBH he avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
.ends nssoc_cml_latch

.subckt nssoc_rx_sampler_hbt dp dn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref
XREF iref iref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XIP dp lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XIN dn ln sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XBP avdd lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1

physical_texts.clock_div2_hbt.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Native HBT master/slave toggle prescaler, not a PLL/CDR or PCIe PHY.
* Include the exact frozen rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice before this subcircuit.
* Master tracks low clock, slave high; slave QN/Q drives master DP/DN.
* Independent nominal2.5V rail and a native resistor/HBT bias reference.
* Small fixed native MIM mismatch supplies a physical startup asymmetry.
* No ideal clock, gain, logic state, IC, UIC or startup current kick exists.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_hbt clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=12.7u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_hbt
physical_texts.clock_div4_hbt_v10.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Separate v10: only second-stage reference XBIAS length12.7um to11.5um; clock pull-downs8um and both24um MIMs retained.
* The first core retains its upward common-mode network. The second network
* lowers the first core's high output common mode; no ideal level shift.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=11.5u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10

.subckt nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XFIRST clkp clkn s1p s1n avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt_v3
* Real input bias, limiter reference and differential pair; no ideal gain.
XLSP s1p bip sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLSN s1n bin sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDP bip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDN bin avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLB avdd lref sub rppd w=1u l=9u b=0 sw_et=1
XLREF lref lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XLP ln bip lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN lp bin lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLT lt lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XLRP avdd lp sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XLRN avdd ln sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
* The unchanged real MIM feed-forward topology preserves clock swing.
XSP lp ckp sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XSN ln ckn sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ckp avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN ckn avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XCP lp ckp cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XCN ln ckn cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XSECOND ckp ckn qp qn avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10
.ends nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10

physical_texts.pll_feedback_div20_lv_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Original finite 2GHz CML-to-CMOS receiver and divide-by-20 prerequisite.
* Two native toggles and a synchronous modulo-five feed a real HV level shifter.
* 1.2V CMOS and 2.5V output supply; no ideal internal clock or divider.
* Isolated schematic development only; no closed PLL, PVT or layout acceptance.
* Original gate topology adapted from the frozen HV PFD; native LV MOS only.
* No ideal internal clock, divider, voltage gain or source.
.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native MIM restrains actual reset-induced n1 charge feedthrough.
XSTAB n1 vss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2 d clk clearb q qb vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XSQB snr q clearb qb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2 cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub
* Native one-third-voltage passive bias matches the measured 2.39V CML CM.
XRP cp ip sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN cn inn sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN inn avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
* Actual LV differential pair/current mirror, not a behavioral comparator.
XRB cvdd bias sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF bias bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XT tail bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=2.96u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNP diode ip tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNN gain inn tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPP diode diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPN gain diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native AC coupling and resistive feedback set the actual inverter bias.
XAC gain gate cap_cmim w=5u l=5u
XRFB pre gate sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XCORE gate pre cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XBUF pre mid cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XOUT mid clk cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2 cp cn clearb q qb avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFF qb clk clearb q qb cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2

* Original synchronous modulo-five; all unused states recover to zero.
.subckt nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub
XFF0 d0 clk clearb q0 q0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF1 d1 clk clearb q1 q1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF2 d2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XD0N q2b q0b d0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD0I d0b d0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XX0 q1 q0 xn0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX1 q1 xn0 xn1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX2 q0 xn0 xn2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX3 xn1 xn2 xq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1N q2b xq d1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1I d1b d1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XD2N q2b q1 q0 d2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XD2I d2b d2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2 d db q qb avdd avss sub
* Real cross-coupled HV PMOS with LV-driven HV NMOS; no voltage gain source.
XPL qb right avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPR right qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNL qb d avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNR right db avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPBUF q qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNBUF q qb avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_div20_v2 cp cn clearb fb fbbar avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFAST0 f0b clk clearb f0 f0b cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFAST1 f1b f0 clearb f1 f1b cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2

XLEVEL count countb fb fbbar avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2

physical_texts.pll_pfd_charge_pump_hv_v1.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut

* Original static HV-CMOS phase/frequency detector and switched mirror pump.
* Nominal AVDD=2.5V. REF/FB/RESET are external full-swing logic inputs.
* RESET is active high. UP/DOWN are active high; positive CP current charges
* an external filter. No internal ideal sources, delay, switches or clocks.
* This is a development primitive, not a closed PLL or a qualified interface.

.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA n a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b n vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB y b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1

* Rising-edge static master/slave DFF; active-low clear resets BOTH latches.
* The clear also inhibits both set inputs, avoiding a clear/set contention.
.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1 d clk clearb q vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQB snr q clearb qb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down vdd vss sub
XUP vdd ref clearb up vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XDN vdd fb clearb down vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XBOTH up down bothb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XD0 bothb delay0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD1 delay0 delay1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD2 delay1 both vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCLR both reset clearb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1

* One resistor-defined NMOS bias sets both the sink and mirrored PMOS source.
* Actual series MOS switches gate the two output paths; compliance is measured.
.subckt nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1 up down out vdd vss sub
XRBIAS vdd nb sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XNREF nb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XNBIAS pb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPREF pb pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPSOURCE source pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=6.4u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPENABLE out upb source vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNENABLE out down sink sub sg13_hv_nmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNSINK sink nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XUB up upb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down cp avdd avss sub
XPFD ref fb reset up down avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1
XCP up down cp avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1
physical_texts.rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Development CML master/slave sampler, not a CDR or complete PCIe PHY.
* External AVDD=2.5 V, AVSS=0 V, IREF=0.5 mA and differential clock required.
* RX v2 remains separately powered from 1.8 V. Native resistive level shift
* loads its actual outputs; no ideal voltage gain or behavioral latch exists.
* Clock target: 8 GHz, common mode 1.29 V, differential levels +/-0.30 V.
* Preamplifier/substrate/pad parasitics are not supplied by this schematic.

.subckt nssoc_cml_latch dp dn qp qn cp cn avdd avss sub ref
XDP qn dp se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XDN qp dn se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLP qn qp he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN qp qn he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XCS se cp te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XCH he cn te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XT te ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XRP avdd qp sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN avdd qn sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
* Weak native bleeders keep the inactive emitter nodes from floating.
XBS se avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XBH he avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
.ends nssoc_cml_latch

.subckt nssoc_rx_sampler_hbt dp dn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref
XREF iref iref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XIP dp lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XIN dn ln sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XBP avdd lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XBN avdd ln sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
* Master tracks low clock; slave tracks high clock, capturing a rising edge.
XM lp ln mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_latch
.ends nssoc_rx_sampler_hbt

physical_texts.clock_div2_hbt.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Native HBT master/slave toggle prescaler, not a PLL/CDR or PCIe PHY.
* Include the exact frozen rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice before this subcircuit.
* Master tracks low clock, slave high; slave QN/Q drives master DP/DN.
* Independent nominal2.5V rail and a native resistor/HBT bias reference.
* Small fixed native MIM mismatch supplies a physical startup asymmetry.
* No ideal clock, gain, logic state, IC, UIC or startup current kick exists.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_hbt clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=12.7u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_hbt
physical_texts.clock_div4_hbt_v10.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Separate v10: only second-stage reference XBIAS length12.7um to11.5um; clock pull-downs8um and both24um MIMs retained.
* The first core retains its upward common-mode network. The second network
* lowers the first core's high output common mode; no ideal level shift.
.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XBIAS avdd ref sub rppd w=1u l=11.5u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF ref ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XM qn qp mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub ref nssoc_cml_latch
XSEEDP mp avss cap_cmim w=2.2u l=2u
XSEEDN mn avss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u
.ends nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10

.subckt nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
XFIRST clkp clkn s1p s1n avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt_v3
* Real input bias, limiter reference and differential pair; no ideal gain.
XLSP s1p bip sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLSN s1n bin sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDP bip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLDN bin avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XLB avdd lref sub rppd w=1u l=9u b=0 sw_et=1
XLREF lref lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XLP ln bip lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN lp bin lt sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLT lt lref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XLRP avdd lp sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XLRN avdd ln sub rppd w=8u l=4.4u b=0 sw_et=1
* The unchanged real MIM feed-forward topology preserves clock swing.
XSP lp ckp sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XSN ln ckn sub rppd w=2u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ckp avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN ckn avss sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1
XCP lp ckp cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XCN ln ckn cap_cmim w=24u l=24u
XSECOND ckp ckn qp qn avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_tail_v10
.ends nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v10

physical_texts.pll_feedback_div20_lv_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Original finite 2GHz CML-to-CMOS receiver and divide-by-20 prerequisite.
* Two native toggles and a synchronous modulo-five feed a real HV level shifter.
* 1.2V CMOS and 2.5V output supply; no ideal internal clock or divider.
* Isolated schematic development only; no closed PLL, PVT or layout acceptance.
* Original gate topology adapted from the frozen HV PFD; native LV MOS only.
* No ideal internal clock, divider, voltage gain or source.
.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.68u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native MIM restrains actual reset-induced n1 charge feedthrough.
XSTAB n1 vss cap_cmim w=2u l=2u

.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2 d clk clearb q qb vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2 cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub
* Native one-third-voltage passive bias matches the measured 2.39V CML CM.
XRP cp ip sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN cn inn sub rppd w=1u l=32u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP ip avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN inn avss sub rppd w=1u l=16u b=0 sw_et=1
* Actual LV differential pair/current mirror, not a behavioral comparator.
XRB cvdd bias sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XREF bias bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XT tail bias avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=2.96u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNP diode ip tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XNN gain inn tail sub sg13_lv_nmos w=1.48u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPP diode diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
XPN gain diode cvdd cvdd sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u ng=1 m=1
* Native AC coupling and resistive feedback set the actual inverter bias.
XAC gain gate cap_cmim w=5u l=5u
XRFB pre gate sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XCORE gate pre cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XBUF pre mid cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XOUT mid clk cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2 cp cn clearb q qb avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFF qb clk clearb q qb cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
.ends nssoc_pll_feedback_toggle_v2

* Original synchronous modulo-five; all unused states recover to zero.
.subckt nssoc_pll_mod5_lv_v2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub
XFF0 d0 clk clearb q0 q0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF1 d1 clk clearb q1 q1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XFF2 d2 clk clearb q2 q2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2
XD0N q2b q0b d0b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD0I d0b d0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XX0 q1 q0 xn0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX1 q1 xn0 xn1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX2 q0 xn0 xn2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XX3 xn1 xn2 xq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1N q2b xq d1b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_lv_fb_v2
XD1I d1b d1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2
XD2N q2b q1 q0 d2b vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_lv_fb_v2
XD2I d2b d2 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_lv_fb_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2 d db q qb avdd avss sub

XPL qb right avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPR right qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNL qb d avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNR right db avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPBUF q qb avdd avdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNBUF q qb avss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_lv_hv_clock_v2

.subckt nssoc_pll_feedback_div20_v2 cp cn clearb fb fbbar avdd cvdd avss sub
XRX cp cn clk avdd cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_cml_lv_receiver_v2
XFAST0 f0b clk clearb f0 f0b cvdd avss sub nssoc_pll_dff_lv_fb_v2

physical_texts.pll_pfd_charge_pump_hv_v1.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Original static HV-CMOS phase/frequency detector and switched mirror pump.
* Nominal AVDD=2.5V. REF/FB/RESET are external full-swing logic inputs.
* RESET is active high. UP/DOWN are active high; positive CP current charges
* an external filter. No internal ideal sources, delay, switches or clocks.
* This is a development primitive, not a closed PLL or a qualified interface.

.subckt nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1 a y vdd vss sub
XP y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XN y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1 a b c y vdd vss sub
XPA y a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=4u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a n1 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB n1 b n2 sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNC n2 c vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=6u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1 a b y vdd vss sub
XPA n a vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XPB y b n vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNA y a vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNB y b vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
.ends nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1

* Rising-edge static master/slave DFF; active-low clear resets BOTH latches.
* The clear also inhibits both set inputs, avoiding a clear/set contention.
.subckt nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1 d clk clearb q vdd vss sub
XDC d db vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCC clk clkb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XMNS d clkb clearb mns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XMNR db clkb mnr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQ mns mqb mq vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XMQB mnr mq clearb mqb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNS mq clk clearb sns vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
XSNR mqb clk snr vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQ sns qb q vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XSQB snr q clearb qb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand3_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down vdd vss sub
XUP vdd ref clearb up vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XDN vdd fb clearb down vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_dff_hv_v1
XBOTH up down bothb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nand2_hv_v1
XD0 bothb delay0 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD1 delay0 delay1 vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XD2 delay1 both vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
XCLR both reset clearb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_nor2_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1

* One resistor-defined NMOS bias sets both the sink and mirrored PMOS source.
* Actual series MOS switches gate the two output paths; compliance is measured.
.subckt nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1 up down out vdd vss sub
XRBIAS vdd nb sub rppd w=1u l=80u b=0 sw_et=1
XNREF nb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XNBIAS pb nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPREF pb pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPSOURCE source pb vdd vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=6.4u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XPENABLE out upb source vdd sg13_hv_pmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNENABLE out down sink sub sg13_hv_nmos w=8u l=0.45u ng=1 m=1
XNSINK sink nb vss sub sg13_hv_nmos w=2u l=2u ng=1 m=1
XUB up upb vdd vss sub nssoc_pll_inv_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1

.subckt nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1 ref fb reset up down cp avdd avss sub
XPFD ref fb reset up down avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_pfd_hv_v1
XCP up down cp avdd avss sub nssoc_pll_charge_pump_hv_v1
.ends nssoc_pll_pfd_cp_hv_v1
physical_texts.rx_sampler_hbt_v2.spice:
* SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
* Development CML master/slave sampler, not a CDR or complete PCIe PHY.
* External AVDD=2.5 V, AVSS=0 V, IREF=0.5 mA and differential clock required.
* RX v2 remains separately powered from 1.8 V. Native resistive level shift
* loads its actual outputs; no ideal voltage gain or behavioral latch exists.
* Clock target: 8 GHz, common mode 1.29 V, differential levels +/-0.30 V.
* Preamplifier/substrate/pad parasitics are not supplied by this schematic.

.subckt nssoc_cml_latch dp dn qp qn cp cn avdd avss sub ref
XDP qn dp se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XDN qp dn se sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLP qn qp he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XLN qp qn he sub npn13G2 Nx=2
XCS se cp te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XCH he cn te sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XT te ref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XRP avdd qp sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
XRN avdd qn sub rppd w=8u l=2.12u b=0 sw_et=1
* Weak native bleeders keep the inactive emitter nodes from floating.
XBS se avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XBH he avss sub rppd w=1u l=38.4u b=0 sw_et=1
.ends nssoc_cml_latch

.subckt nssoc_rx_sampler_hbt dp dn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref
XREF iref iref avss sub npn13G2 Nx=1
XIP dp lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XIN dn ln sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XBP avdd lp sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
XBN avdd ln sub rppd w=1u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
* Master tracks low clock; slave tracks high clock, capturing a rising edge.
XM lp ln mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_latch
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_latch
.ends nssoc_rx_sampler_hbt
